Nouriel Roubini’s RGE is ‘not yet profitable’ and may be up for sale according to [Institutional Investor](http://www.institutionalinvestor.com/Article/2915937/How-Nouriel-Roubini-Became-a-Research-Brand.html). This made me laugh:

> *For RGE’s senior analysts, getting it right requires gaining a deep understanding of Roubini’s distinctive approach to macroeconomic research.*

Good luck with that!
